name: Epidemiology PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 application confirmed. BGS common policies supplemented with degree-specific requirements; admission model omitted where not established.

applicationFee.note: No fee to apply to BGS; no waiver needed.

english.note: BGS accepts TOEFL/IELTS/DET without numerical minimum. US or approved English-instructed degree exempts after review; no separate waiver request needed. Official reports by deadline; expired TOEFL requires retake. International intake highly competitive and limited.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all institutions plus translations
requirements.note: Accredited undergraduate or first graduate degree. Master/equivalent graduate coursework suggested, not required. Prior coursework should include calculus; statistics encouraged. Bachelor-only applicants advised relevant work/research, typically 2–3 years among successful candidates, explicitly not a formal requirement. Current admissions supersedes older handbook master/two-year requirement.

funding.note: Current Epidemiology admissions: fellowship for first 16 months covers tuition, fees, health insurance and stipend for full-time students in good standing; Fall 2026 stipend$49,000. Before 16 months student must identify dissertation project with confirmed subsequent funding; otherwise may be removed. Prior professional-degree applicants must secure entire funding per BGS. Older handbook 21-month statement superseded.
